name: Sakaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sakaki town emblem in red: a ring crossed by a horizontal bar with a stylised character, like the character 坂.
history: Municipal flag of Sakaki, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1955.

features.role: Sakaki town emblem — a ring crossed by a horizontal bar with a stylised character, like the character 坂
